blog_intro: I've decided to call them all "devices", because we've made them all up, and they're useful. Since then, I've told that 8-year-old kid that if he wants to save the world by making flying cars and holograms, he's gotta start by making people believe that cars can fly in the first place.
newsletter_body: Insights on digital creation, technology, and commentary on our digital future. Delivered when inspiration strikes.
